d: Our client is a leading global asset management firm with a well-established international presence and a growing institutional platform across the Middle East.
The firm provides sophisticated investment solutions across multiple asset classes, including fixed income, equities, private markets, real estate, and alternative investments.

As part of its continued regional expansion, our client is seeking an experienced and commercially driven Senior Relationship Manager at Director or Executive Director level to strengthen its institutional distribution capabilities and expand its presence across the UAE.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and managing strategic relationships with institutional investors, sovereign wealth funds, financial institutions, and leading family offices across the UAE, with a particular focus on Abu Dhabi and Dubai.

This is a senior, client-facing position requiring an established network of institutional investors, a strong understanding of investment products, and a demonstrated ability to originate opportunities and raise capital across multiple asset classes.
The role offers an opportunity to contribute to the growth of an established global investment platform in one of the region's most important financial markets.
q: Minimum 10–15+ years of experience in institutional business development, relationship management, or investment distribution.
Strong professional background within asset management, investment banking, financial institutions, private equity, or related investment businesses.
Established institutional investor network across the UAE , particularly Abu Dhabi and Dubai.
Existing relationships with sovereign wealth funds, institutional investors, banks, insurance companies, pension funds, endowments, and leading family offices.
Proven ability to originate investment opportunities, develop strategic relationships, and raise institutional capital.
Strong understanding of investment products and institutional distribution.
Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
Fluent English, both written and spoken.
Commercially driven, proactive, confident, and capable of operating independently while collaborating with international teams.
Existing investor relationships across additional GCC markets.
Experience distributing fixed income and credit investment strategies .
Arabic language proficiency would be a significant advantage.
Join a globally established asset management platform with a growing Middle East presence.
Play a key role in developing institutional relationships and expanding regional distribution.
Work closely with experienced investment professionals and international investment teams.
Access a broad range of institutional investment strategies and solutions.
Benefit from a comprehensive employment package, including healthcare coverage, annual leave, and additional employee benefits.
r: Develop and execute business development initiatives targeting institutional investors across the UAE.
Originate new investment opportunities and drive capital raising across various investment strategies and asset classes.
Identify and engage prospective investors, introducing relevant investment solutions aligned with their objectives.
Expand the firm's institutional presence and strengthen its positioning within the UAE investment community.
Manage and develop long-term relationships with sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, banks, insurance companies, endowments, and family offices.
Leverage an established network of institutional investors to generate new business opportunities.
Maintain regular engagement with existing and prospective clients through meetings, presentations, and strategic discussions.
Build relationships with Tier I and Tier II family offices and ultra-high-net-worth investors.
Work closely with global investment teams to introduce relevant strategies to institutional clients.
Support the distribution of investment solutions across fixed income, credit, equities, alternatives, and other asset classes.
Understand investor requirements and align investment strategies with their allocation objectives.
Facilitate discussions between institutional investors and relevant investment specialists.
Monitor institutional investment trends, capital allocation priorities, and competitive developments across the UAE.
Provide market intelligence, investor feedback, and strategic insights to regional leadership.
Maintain accurate client coverage records, meeting notes, and prospective investor information.
Contribute to the development of regional distribution and investor coverage strategies.

d: مجمع الدكتور ساعد الحارثي الطبي – الرياض، حي الصحافة

يعلن مجمع الدكتور ساعد الحارثي الطبي عن توفر فرصة وظيفية لمدير عمليات يتمتع بخبرة عملية في إدارة وتشغيل المنشآت الصحية، ولديه القدرة على قيادة الفريق الإداري، وتطوير العمليات التشغيلية، ورفع الكفاءة وجودة الخدمات المقدمة للمرضى.
الإشراف الكامل على العمليات الإدارية والتشغيلية اليومية للمجمع.
إدارة الموظفين الإداريين ومتابعة الحضور والانصراف والأداء الوظيفي.
متابعة أداء الاستقبال وخدمة المرضى وتحسين تجربة المراجعين.
متابعة الإيرادات والتحصيل والمصروفات ورفع الكفاءة التشغيلية.
الإشراف على العمليات الإدارية المرتبطة بالتأمين الطبي والمطالبات.
إعداد التقارير التشغيلية والمالية الدورية ومؤشرات الأداء (KPIs).
تطوير إجراءات العمل وتحسين الإنتاجية وجودة الخدمات.
التنسيق المستمر مع المدير الطبي لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة.
استخدام التقنيات الحديثة وأدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي لتحسين العمليات وتحليل البيانات وإعداد التقارير.
درجة البكالوريوس في الإدارة الصحية أو إدارة الأعمال أو تخصص ذي صلة.
خبرة لا تقل عن 3 سنوات في إدارة وتشغيل المنشآت الصحية، ويفضل المجمعات الطبية الخاصة.
خبرة سابقة في منصب إداري أو إشرافي بالقطاع الصحي.
معرفة جيدة بالتشغيل الصحي والتأمين الطبي وإدارة الإيرادات.
مهارات قيادية عالية وقدرة على اتخاذ القرارات وحل المشكلات.
إجادة استخدام Microsoft Office، خصوصًا Excel.
الإلمام بأدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي (AI Tools)، مثل ChatGPT وMicrosoft Copilot، والقدرة على الاستفادة منها في تطوير العمل.
الانضباط والالتزام والقدرة على تحمل المسؤولية والعمل باستقلالية.
راتب تنافسي يحدد بناءً على الخبرة والكفاءة.
نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل – حضوري (Full-time / On-site)

The Quality Audit & Inspection Specialist is responsible for conducting operational quality audits and safety inspections across dark stores, warehouses, and last-mile delivery operations. The role ensures compliance with established operational procedures, product handling and storage standards, food safety requirements where applicable, and delivery service standards. The specialist will identify operational risks and process deviations, document findings, coordinate corrective actions with relevant teams, and drive continuous improvements to ensure operational efficiency, product quality, and safety across the entire fulfillment chain.
q: Previous experience in retail operations, quality assurance, operational auditing, warehouse management, or last-mile delivery operations.
Good understanding of dark store and warehouse operations, including goods receiving, storage, inventory control, picking, packing, and dispatch.
Knowledge of last-mile delivery processes and the operational standards required to maintain delivery quality, product integrity, and rider compliance.
Understanding of product characteristics and storage requirements across refrigerated, frozen, and ambient categories.
Strong English communication, reporting, and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and drive improvements related to quality issues.
Valid driving license and ability to travel between dark stores, warehouses, and other operational sites as required.
Proficiency in using inspection systems, audit checklists, reporting forms, and standard office software.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify operational abnormalities, investigate root causes, and recommend effective corrective actions.
High levels of integrity, accountability, and attention to detail, ensuring accurate reporting and consistent application of audit standards.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple inspection activities, and follow up on corrective actions to ensure sustainable improvements.
r: Conduct regular quality audits and safety inspections across dark stores, warehouses, and last-mile delivery operations to ensure compliance with established operational standards and procedures.

Inspect warehouse and dark store operations, including goods receiving, storage, inventory management, order picking, packing, dispatch, and product handling, to identify quality issues and operational risks.
Monitor product storage conditions and handling practices across refrigerated, frozen, and ambient categories to ensure compliance with applicable quality and safety requirements.
Inspect last-mile delivery processes, including order handover, rider compliance, delivery handling, and product condition upon dispatch, to identify service quality issues and potential risks.
Accurately document audit findings, inspection results, and operational abnormalities, ensuring the integrity and reliability of all inspection records.
Maintain a thorough understanding of audit criteria, inspection checklists, safety requirements, and operational standards across all areas of responsibility.
Conduct special audits and targeted inspections in response to recurring quality issues, operational incidents, safety concerns, or specific business requirements.
Analyze inspection findings, identify recurring issues and root causes, and prepare reports highlighting non-compliance, operational risks, and improvement opportunities.
Coordinate with warehouse, dark store, last-mile, and other relevant operational teams to implement corrective and preventive actions and ensure timely resolution of identified issues.
Follow up on corrective actions, verify their effectiveness, and ensure that repeated violations or process deviations are addressed appropriately.
Recommend improvements to operational processes, inspection procedures, and quality standards based on audit findings and operational performance trends.
Support the continuous improvement of quality, safety, and operational compliance across the end-to-end fulfillment chain.
